newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore to focus on small-cap stocks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore to focus on small-cap stocks.

text.p: Trading of small-capitalised companies is seen dominating the Singapore stock market on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Investors are moving into smaller-cap stocks. Their valuations are looking more attractive after recent declines," said a dealer, adding most of them have also reported good earnings.
Sentiment should also be underpined by strong gains in Wall Street stocks overnight, he said.

Dealers said engineering-based Van der Horst could see further upside after some research houses upgraded the stock to buy even after it posted an 84-percent drop in net profit for six months ended March 31, 1997.
The Straits Times Industrials Index ended 6.59 points up at 2,041.38 on Tuesday.
